title: Loop+ Membership Plan Fee Schedule
content:
Each of the six Loop+ Membership plans charges one membership fee per billing cycle. The fee is stated in US dollars, the billing cycle is stated as the number of months one fee covers, and a change to a plan's fee carries a fixed number of calendar days of notice before it applies at renewal.

## Schedule

| Plan | Membership fee per billing cycle (USD) | Months covered by one fee | Calendar days of notice before a fee change applies at renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 6.99 | 1 | 30 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 7.49 | 1 | 30 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 69.00 | 12 | 30 |
| Loop+ Monthly | 14.99 | 1 | 30 |
| Loop+ Annual | 139.00 | 12 | 30 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 179.00 | 12 | 30 |

## Terms used in this schedule

- **Membership fee**: the fee per billing cycle, in USD.
- **Billing cycle**: the months covered by one fee, a whole number. Plans whose fee covers 1 month are the monthly plans (Loop+ Access Monthly, Loop+ Student Monthly and Loop+ Monthly); plans whose fee covers 12 months are the annual plans (Loop+ Student Annual, Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual).
- **Price change notice**: the calendar days of notice before a fee change applies at renewal. Every Loop+ Membership plan carries 30 calendar days.

## Reading the schedule

- A Loop+ Monthly member pays 14.99 for each one-month cycle; a Loop+ Annual member pays 139.00 for each twelve-month cycle.
- The two student plans differ in billing cycle and fee: Loop+ Student Monthly charges 7.49 per one-month cycle and Loop+ Student Annual charges 69.00 per twelve-month cycle.
- Loop+ Household Annual carries the highest fee in the Loop+ Membership family, 179.00 per twelve-month cycle, and Loop+ Access Monthly the lowest, 6.99 per one-month cycle.
